# Format: <rule-id>\t<command>

# rm-rf-root
rm-rf-root	rm -rf /
rm-rf-root	rm -fr /
rm-rf-root	rm -rfv /
rm-rf-root	cd /tmp && rm -rf /

# rm-rf-home
rm-rf-home	rm -rf $HOME
rm-rf-home	rm -rf $HOME/
rm-rf-home	rm -rf ~
rm-rf-home	rm -rf ~/
rm-rf-home	rm -rf /home/dev
rm-rf-home	rm -rf /Users/alice/
rm-rf-home	rm -rf /home/runner

# rm-no-preserve
rm-no-preserve	rm -rf --no-preserve-root /
rm-no-preserve	sudo rm -rf --no-preserve-root /tmp/x

# rm-rf-glob
rm-rf-glob	rm -rf *
rm-rf-glob	rm -fr *
rm-rf-glob	rm -rfv *
